purpose.sales: What sold, by day, product, category, size, colour, channel, zone or payment.
purpose.orders: How many orders reach the customer, and why others are cancelled or returned.
purpose.inventory: What the stock is worth, what is running low and what is not selling.
purpose.finance: Revenue, discounts, refunds, delivery money and the cash still with couriers.
purpose.courier: Delivery rates, speed and cost per parcel, and the cash each courier owes.
purpose.customers: New against returning customers, guest conversion and the biggest spenders.
purpose.pnl: Profit and loss for a period, with expenses by category.

landing.subtitle: Pick a report. Every report can be filtered by dates and branch, bookmarked and exported.

filters.daysHint: Dead stock: items with no sale for this many days.

filters.scopeAll: Showing everything you may see, added together.

notices.costHidden: Cost, profit and stock value at cost are hidden because you do not have access to cost prices in every branch shown. They are not zero: they are simply not shown to you.
notices.gatewayFees: Payment gateway fees are not recorded by the system, so they are shown as "not recorded" and are not deducted. Real profit after fees is lower by that amount.
notices.truncated: This list was cut at its limit. Narrow the dates or the branch to see everything; the totals above are exact.
notices.costMissing: {count, plural, one {# sold line has} other {# sold lines have}} no cost price saved, so their cost counts as zero and profit may be overstated.
